question: Whom can the purifying practitioners elevate through their association?
premises: Their associates include mlecchas, śvapacas, and lowly people.
Purifying power extends to those associates.
inference: Therefore these practitioners purify even their mleccha, śvapaca, and lowly associates.
plain_english: They purify their own associates, even mlecchas, śvapacas, and other lowly people.
